title: Literals that are the same knob written at several sites
body:
Values that are the same number or string at several sites. Some are one knob written out more than once; others are separate knobs that happen to share a value, and the issue is deciding which.

| value | sites | one knob? |
|---|---|---|
| `"decade"` as a directory or app name | `control.rs` 25 (runtime dir), `save.rs` 109 (state dir), `settings.rs` 111 (config dir), `main.rs` 72 (`viewer::run("decade")`), `menu.rs` 263 (palette title) | the three directory names, yes |
| `"XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"` | `control.rs` 22, `compositor.rs` 469, `hypr.rs` 22 | yes; see "Runtime and XDG directories are computed in six places" |
| `"DECADE_PANE"` | set at `compositor.rs` 701 and 1842, read in `decade-channel` | yes on the server side |
| 4096 read chunk | `viewer.rs` 805, `compositor.rs` 1722 | yes; see "One non-blocking line reader for Hyprland events and channel clients" |
| 1000 ms | `CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS`, the repeat-rate clamp at `compositor.rs` 394, `1000 / rate` at 2708, `poll(.., 1000)` in `script.rs`, a range cap in `settings.rs` | no, except the two repeat-rate sites |
| 50 ms | `control::POLL`, `bar_hold_ms` and `grab_ms` defaults in `settings.rs` | no |
| 5 ms | `OUTBOX_RETRY` in `compositor.rs`, a literal in `viewer.rs` 158 | yes; see "The wire protocol's constants live in the clients instead of wire.rs" |
| 1 s | `FORMATS_WAIT`, `SAVE_DELAY` | no |
| 24 and 40 | `frame::OPEN_WIDTH`, `picker::MIN_BUTTON`, `menu::WIDTH` | no |
| JSON schema keys in `mcp.rs` | `"description"`, `"object"`, `"properties"`, `"required"`, `"string"` seven to nine times each, though `schema()` exists | a helper per field would remove them |

## Proposal

Name the rows marked yes once each; the rest are covered by the issues cited or are separate knobs.
close_reason: Done in 80f88cd. files::DIR names decade's directory once. A note on this issue says why the other rows stay.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/913b1d2c
notes.text:
Re-surveyed on the current tree. Of the rows marked yes, only the three directory names were still written out more than once. `files::DIR` covers them now. The others had already gone:

- `DECADE_PANE` is set in one place on the server, `Children::command` in `children.rs`.
- The 4096-byte read chunk lives only in `lines.rs`.
- The 5 ms retry is `wire::OUTBOX_RETRY`, used by the compositor and the viewer.

Left as they are:

- `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` in `hypr.rs`: Hyprland's sockets sit under the real runtime directory, so `Hyprland::find` gives up when the variable is unset. `files::runtime_dir` falls back to the temp directory instead. They are different lookups.
- The repeat rate: `1000 / rate` in `start_repeat` converts a per-second rate to milliseconds. The `rate.min(1000)` clamp in `viewers.rs` keeps that interval at 1 ms or more. Naming one constant for both would hide the unit conversion.
- The JSON schema keys in `mcp.rs`: the `json!` literals read as JSON Schema itself. A helper per field would hide the schema behind another notation.
